description: This file defines the 'pData' class used to manipulate data arrays for charting purposes, including series management, axis configuration, palette handling, data import/export, and statistical computations within the pChart library.

classes.name: pData
classes.description: A class to manage dataset series, axes configurations, palettes, and statistical computations for chart rendering within the pChart library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new pData object with default axis and series configurations.

methods.name: addPoints
methods.description: Adds one or multiple data points to a specified series.

methods.name: stripVOID
methods.description: Removes VOID values from a data array.

methods.name: getSerieCount
methods.description: Returns the number of data points in a series.

methods.name: removeSerie
methods.description: Removes a specified series from the dataset.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves a specific data point from a series at a given index.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns all data points in a series.

methods.name: reverseSerie
methods.description: Reverses the order of data points in specified series.

methods.name: getSum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of data points in a series.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum value in a series.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum value in a series.

methods.name: setSerieShape
methods.description: Sets the shape (marker) for a series.

methods.name: setSerieDescription
methods.description: Sets a description for a series.

methods.name: setSerieDrawable
methods.description: Marks a series as drawable for rendering.

methods.name: setSeriePicture
methods.description: Associates a picture or icon with a series.

methods.name: setXAxisName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the X axis.

methods.name: setXAxisDisplay
methods.description: Defines the display mode and format of the X axis.

methods.name: setXAxisUnit
methods.description: Sets the unit label for the X axis.

methods.name: setAbscissa
methods.description: Assigns a series to be used as the X axis (abscissa).

methods.name: setAbsicssaPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the X axis.

methods.name: setAbscissaName
methods.description: Sets the label name of the abscissa axis.

methods.name: setScatterSerie
methods.description: Creates a scatter group with specified X and Y series.

methods.name: setScatterSerieShape
methods.description: Sets the shape of a specific scatter series.

methods.name: setScatterSerieDescription
methods.description: Sets a description for a scatter series.

methods.name: setScatterSeriePicture
methods.description: Associates a picture with a scatter series.

methods.name: setScatterSerieDrawable
methods.description: Marks a scatter series as drawable.

methods.name: setScatterSerieTicks
methods.description: Defines if scatter series should be drawn with ticks.

methods.name: setScatterSerieWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight (thickness) of scatter series markers.

methods.name: setScatterSerieColor
methods.description: Assigns a color to a scatter series.

methods.name: limits
methods.description: Calculates the global and individual limits of series for scaling.

methods.name: drawAll
methods.description: Marks all series as drawable for rendering.

methods.name: getSerieAverage
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average of a series.

methods.name: getGeometricMean
methods.description: Calculates the geometric mean of a series.

methods.name: getHarmonicMean
methods.description: Calculates the harmonic mean of a series.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Computes the standard deviation of a series.

methods.name: getCoefficientOfVariation
methods.description: Returns the coefficient of variation of a series.

methods.name: getSerieMedian
methods.description: Returns the median value of a series.

methods.name: getSeriePercentile
methods.description: Returns a specified percentile value of a series.

methods.name: addRandomValues
methods.description: Fills a series with random values based on options.

methods.name: containsData
methods.description: Checks if there is drawable data in the dataset.

methods.name: setAxisDisplay
methods.description: Configures the display mode and format of an axis.

methods.name: setAxisPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of an axis.

methods.name: setAxisUnit
methods.description: Associates a unit label to an axis.

methods.name: setAxisName
methods.description: Labels an axis.

methods.name: setAxisColor
methods.description: Sets the color of an axis.

methods.name: setAxisXY
methods.description: Designates an axis as X or Y.

methods.name: setSerieOnAxis
methods.description: Associates series with specific axes.

methods.name: setSerieTicks
methods.description: Defines tick marks for a series.

methods.name: setSerieWeight
methods.description: Sets the line weight for a series.

methods.name: getSeriePalette
methods.description: Returns the color palette used by a series.

methods.name: setPalette
methods.description: Sets colors for one or multiple series.

methods.name: loadPalette
methods.description: Loads palette data from a file.

methods.name: initScatterSerie
methods.description: Initializes a scatter series configuration.

methods.name: initialise
methods.description: Creates a new series with default settings.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes data series to a specified scale.

methods.name: importFromCSV
methods.description: Imports data into series from a CSV file.

methods.name: createFunctionSerie
methods.description: Creates a dataset series based on a mathematical formula.

methods.name: negateValues
methods.description: Negates the values in specified series.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the entire data set and configuration.

methods.name: savePalette
methods.description: Saves a color into the internal palette array.

methods.name: getPalette
methods.description: Returns the current color palette.

methods.name: saveAxisConfig
methods.description: Saves axis configuration data.

methods.name: saveYMargin
methods.description: Saves Y-axis margin value.

methods.name: saveExtendedData
methods.description: Saves extended configuration data.

methods.name: saveOrientation
methods.description: Saves the orientation of the chart.

methods.name: convertToArray
methods.description: Converts a value into an array with one element.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: left
methods.description: Returns the left substring of a string.

methods.name: right
methods.description: Returns the right substring of a string.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns a substring from the middle of a string.
